concerns.text: T011 (EBD download) and T012 (MODIS download) are marked [P] (parallel-safe), but T013 (grid aggregation) and T014 (first arrival derivation) depend on the *output files* of T011 and T012. While T011/T012 can run in parallel, the dependency chain T011/T012 -> T013 -> T014 is not explicitly enforced in the task list structure, risking T013 starting before T011/T012 complete. The 'Dependencies & Execution Order' section mentions this, but the task list itself lacks explicit 'depends-on' markers or sequential grouping to prevent race conditions in a parallel runner.

T019 (feature engineering) and T020 (temporal split) depend on the output of T014/T015 (first_arrival_sweep.csv). The task list places US2 tasks immediately after US1 tasks but does not explicitly state that T019 cannot start until T015 completes. If a parallel runner picks up T019 before T015 finishes writing `data/processed/first_arrival_sweep.csv`, the pipeline will fail or read partial data. The 'Dependencies' section notes this, but the task list needs explicit ordering constraints (e.g., 'Depends on T015') to be executable safely.

T030 (threshold sensitivity) explicitly depends on `data/processed/first_arrival_sweep.csv` (from T015), and T031 (metrics aggregation) depends on T028 (bootstrap) and T029 (statistical comparison). T028 depends on the model output from US2 (T022/T023). The current list groups T028-T031 together but does not clearly separate the US2 dependency from the US1 dependency. T030 should be explicitly marked as dependent on T015, and T031 must be strictly sequential after T028/T029. The current [P] tags on T028 and T029 are correct, but T031 is marked [~] (incomplete) without a clear dependency chain to T028/T029 in the task list itself.

T032 (regional map) depends on US2 model output (T025) and US1 data (T014). T037 (runtime validation) depends on the full pipeline (T011-T031). While the 'Dependencies' section states Phase 6 depends on all US stories, the task list does not explicitly mark T032 as dependent on T025 or T037 as dependent on T031. This ambiguity could lead to T032 running before the model is trained or T037 running before all metrics are generated.
